# Transporeon: API for Shippers and Partners v2

- **Product:** Transporeon: API for Shippers and Partners v2 (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** HTTP basic or OAuth 2.0 (Transporeon). Declared security schemes: basic, oauth2_prod, oauth2_test.
- **Access:** Shippers and partners on Transporeon.
- **To call it you would need:** Transporeon shipper API credentials for xp.transporeon.com.
- **Documented servers:** `https://xp.transporeon.com/openapi`, `https://xp.test.transporeon.com/openapi`.
- **Definition:** [transporeon/transporeon-openapi-v2-swagger-json](https://xch.transporeon.com/openapi/v2/swagger.json) (Transporeon OpenAPI for Shippers and Partners v2, version 2.1.51). Documentation: https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/27230413/API+for+Shippers+and+Partners+v2, https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/27231864/Technical+Descriptions.

## Bookings

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v2/bookings` | `reference` | Returns all bookings for a given booking number | booking_number* (query); clientid (query) |
| `GET` | `/v2/bookings/pull` | `reference` | Pulls all bookings which were created, modified or deleted since the last poll. | transactional (query); clientid (query) |
| `POST` | `/v2/dispatch_statuses` | `reference` | Pushes dispatch statuses for asynchronous processing. | body: application/json, application/xml |
| `POST` | `/v2/open_bookings` | `reference` | Pushes open bookings for asynchronous processing. | body: application/json, application/xml |
